verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a SaaS card-issuing platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents any data residency or region-selection capability. The mention of EU, UK, and US banking licenses is about regulatory licensing, not about where customer data is stored, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
